title.zh-CN: 长程发热、跛行与重度贫血 · 3岁9月女孩
title.en: Prolonged fever, limp and severe anaemia · girl aged 3 years 9 months

summary.zh-CN: 曾对激素退热并不能确认风湿病，局灶骨痛和不协调血象需要重启肿瘤及感染鉴别。
summary.en: Steroid-responsive fever does not confirm rheumatic disease; focal skeletal symptoms and discordant counts require reassessment for malignancy and infection.

prompt.zh-CN: 什么情况要求重启JIA之外的鉴别？
prompt.en: What requires reopening the differential beyond JIA?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 局灶骨病变、重度贫血和血小板下降要求肿瘤与骨感染评估
text.en: Focal bone disease, severe anaemia and thrombocytopenia warrant malignancy and osteomyelitis assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 退热反应并不具有病因特异性。
feedback.en: Defervescence on steroids is not disease-specific.

text.zh-CN: 激素能退热就确证JIA
text.en: Steroid-responsive fever confirms JIA

feedback.zh-CN: 许多炎症或肿瘤症状也可短暂受抑制。
feedback.en: Inflammatory and malignant symptoms can be temporarily suppressed.

text.zh-CN: 平片未见破坏即可排除骨肿瘤
text.en: No radiographic destruction excludes a bone tumour

feedback.zh-CN: MRI和CT已提供更明显病灶证据。
feedback.en: MRI and CT already show significant disease.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 活检支持尤文方向，但现代分子分型和每处病灶属性仍需核实
text.en: Biopsy supports Ewing disease, while modern molecular classification and individual lesions need confirmation

feedback.zh-CN: PET高代谢不等于每处均已病理确证。
feedback.en: PET avidity is not histological proof at every site.

text.zh-CN: 所有PET热点必然是已确证转移
text.en: Every PET hotspot is proven metastasis

feedback.zh-CN: 炎症等亦可摄取，需综合分期。
feedback.en: Inflammation can also be avid; integrate staging evidence.

text.zh-CN: 初始骨髓未见肿瘤就排除实体骨肿瘤
text.en: An initially negative marrow excludes a solid bone tumour

feedback.zh-CN: 局灶实体病灶需直接组织评估。
feedback.en: A focal solid lesion requires direct tissue assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何避免进一步延误和损害后续治疗？
prompt.en: How can further delay and disruption of definitive care be avoided?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 儿肿瘤及骨肿瘤团队规划活检路径、分子确认和全身分期，复核激素影响
text.en: Paediatric and bone-tumour teams should plan biopsy, molecular confirmation and staging and review steroid effects

feedback.zh-CN: 不应只反复经验激素或在未规划路径下随意切除。
feedback.en: Avoid repeated empirical steroids or unplanned excision.

text.zh-CN: 再加激素至退热即可停止调查
text.en: Increase steroids until fever resolves and stop investigation

feedback.zh-CN: 可能继续掩盖重大病因。
feedback.en: This can further mask important disease.

text.zh-CN: 因年龄小就排除恶性肿瘤并观察
text.en: Young age excludes malignancy and permits observation

feedback.zh-CN: 幼龄并不排除恶性骨肿瘤。
feedback.en: Young age does not exclude malignant bone disease.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：识别发热跛行中的肿瘤红旗。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：融合分型、每处病灶组织、完整治疗与长期生存功能。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Identify malignant red flags in fever with limp. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Fusion classification, individual lesion histology, full treatment and long-term survival/function. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告右髂骨尤文瘤多骨病灶，曾被JIA标签与激素退热反应延误识别。
conclusion.en: The source reports right iliac Ewing tumour with multiple bone lesions, initially obscured by a JIA label and steroid-responsive fever.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

testUtterances.text: 发热已经多久，每天发几次？

Has this fever lasted more than two months?

When did limping or reluctance to walk begin?
最初关节有明显肿痛吗？
Were joints clearly swollen or painful at first?

有没有掉头发或皮肤出血点？
Was there hair loss or petechiae?

Did previous treatment improve symptoms?

What was health like before this illness?
